title: The Leap
description: A Modpack with several tech, QOL and building mods while still keeping the vanilla progression
body:
![The leap](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b22f5e7b370e9cd60bccf3a3093cab28316bca52.png)

The Leap is a modpack that pushes Minecraft forward without throwing away what makes vanilla fun. You still progress the normal way, just with way more to build, automate and explore.

**Create** and **Mekanism** power up your world with proper engineering and late-game tech, while dozens of **building and decoration** mods open up huge creative freedom. **Better End**, new structures and extra world content make exploration actually feel fresh. **Performance mods** keep everything smooth, and **QoL** tweaks cut out the annoying stuff without making the game easier than it should be.

If you want a pack that upgrades Minecraft’s possibilities without breaking its soul, this is it.
